title: Founding myths of star people teaching agriculture

tellings.quote: And just about every founding myth talks about people from the stars, you know, teaching us agriculture.

plain: Nearly every culture's founding myth is said to describe people from the stars who taught humans agriculture. Michels says this himself, without naming any particular myth, in his episode with the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb. If true, it would hint that ancient peoples remembered contact with visitors from elsewhere.
